info.title: ShortPen Universal API
info.description: Create, track, and manage branded links and QR codes

get.description: Checks connectivity to the ShortPen API.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

post.description: Creates a new link in ShortPen.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

url.description: Destination URL that will be shortened.

domain_id.description: ID of the domain that will host the short link. Use List Domains to find valid IDs.

workspace_id.description: Optional workspace override when the key can access multiple workspaces.

title.description: Optional human-friendly title for the link.

custom_slug.description: Branded slug to append instead of an auto-generated code.

folder_id.description: Existing folder to assign the link to. Use List Folders to find valid IDs.

generate_qr.description: Generate and return a QR code for the new link.

enable_tracking.description: Associate the link with a tracking pixel. Requires Pixel ID.

pixel_id.description: Pixel identifier used when tracking is enabled. Use List Pixels to find valid IDs.

hide_referer.description: Remove the referrer header for visitors.

with_password.description: Protect the link behind a password.

url_password.description: Password required when password protection is enabled.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.
